source_checks.finding: Google Gmail Help page is for Gmail on a computer. The computer steps are on the page: open Gmail on your computer; click the Settings icon at the top right, then 'See all settings'; under the General tab, go to the Vacation responder section; select 'Vacation responder on'; fill in the date range, subject and message; optionally check the box under the message to limit replies to your contacts; click 'Save Changes' at the bottom. The page does not give the checkbox's exact label. The excerpt in the ref ('In most cases, your reply is only sent to people the first time they message you.' ) is on the page but does not support the setup section it is attached to. The setup claims are supported by the page's steps, so the card should cite those steps instead of this excerpt.

Same Gmail Help page, for Gmail on a computer. The section 'Learn how an automatic reply works' says: 'Your automatic reply starts at 12:00 AM on the start date and ends at 11:59 PM on the end date, unless you end it earlier.' The cited excerpt matches this sentence exactly.

required_actions.action: Click the Settings icon at the top right, then See all settings
On the General tab, scroll to the Vacation responder section
Enter the date range (December 1 to December 8, given by the user), a subject and a message
Check the optional box under the message to send replies only to contacts (the user asked for this option)
Click Save Changes at the bottom of the page
Reply window starts 12:00 AM on the start date and ends 11:59 PM on the end date unless ended earlier
Automatic replies are usually sent only the first time each person writes
